title: Unlit drones hovering over 400 ft above Picatinny Arsenal

tellings.quote: These were lights off over 400 feet over Pikatini Arsenal, just sitting there.

plain: In 2024, drones with their lights off are said to have hovered, just sitting there, more than 400 feet above Picatinny Arsenal, a US military site in New Jersey. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once took part in recovering a UFO, tells this as something he saw himself. In his words: "These were lights off over 400 feet over Picatinny Arsenal, just sitting there."
